units.title: Introduction to Pollution and its Impact
topics: 1.1. Define pollution and pollutant
1.2. Classify pollutants & pollution

units.title: Air Pollution Control
topics: 2.1. Define Air Pollution,
2.2. Pollutants and its sources
2.3. Classification: primary & secondary, gaseous & particulate

2.7. Methods to Control Nitrogen Oxides (NOₓ) (a) Modification of operating condition (b) Modification of design condition
